name: Larry's Original Custom Tailors
whatItIs: Custom-made men's suits and shirts plus precision alterations, serving Houston men since 1975.
whyNotable: Fully bespoke suits cut from scratch with 3,000+ fabric swatches, run by a beloved old-school tailor.
evidence: Own site plus positive independent reviews

name: Nick Lopez Tailoring
whatItIs: Boutique tailor making custom men's suits with old-world, hand-stitched construction.
whyNotable: Over 35 years crafting 100% hand-stitched canvas coats, cited on Houston's top bespoke-clothing lists.

name: Saad's Tailors
whatItIs: Tailoring shop offering Italian ready-made suits and shirts alongside men's custom apparel and alterations.
whyNotable: 45 years of local reputation for superior fabrics and design, ranked among Houston's top suit-alteration shops.
evidence: Expertise.com profile and Yelp Suit Alterations top-10

name: Memorial Tailors
whatItIs: Tailor shop specializing in suit alterations and tailoring for Houston men.
whyNotable: Repeatedly called out by name in Yelp reviews as the shop people 'unhesitatingly recommend' for suit work.
evidence: Multiple Yelp 'Best Suit Alterations Houston' listings

name: Star Tailor & Alterations
whatItIs: Alterations shop known for precise suit and trouser fitting work for local men.
whyNotable: Called an 'unsung hero of tailoring' by reviewers, with a tailor (Nguyen) singled out by name for suit fittings.
evidence: Yelp Suit Alterations and Heights-area tailor rankings

name: Bay Area Custom Clothing
whatItIs: Mobile custom clothier bringing fine Italian and English suit, sport coat, and shirt fabrics to clients' doors.
whyNotable: Skips the shop entirely — a 30-year operator who fits and delivers custom suits at your home or office.

name: Knot Standard Houston
whatItIs: Custom and made-to-measure suit retailer with a genuine Houston showroom for local fittings.
whyNotable: Praised for hitting a rare balance of price, quality, and service for custom suiting in Houston.

name: Ahmed's Custom Clothiers
whatItIs: Custom tailor making made-to-order men's suits and shirts, including monogrammed embroidery.
whyNotable: Near-perfect 4.9 rating with clients praising flawless wedding suits and years-long customer loyalty.

name: Kick Game
whatItIs: Sneaker consignment and resale boutique selling rare, secondhand designer and collaboration sneakers to collectors.
whyNotable: Long-running Houston consignment spot specifically for hard-to-find designer and luxury-collab sneakers, not fast-fashion resale.
evidence: Known local sneaker-consignment retailer; store listings/prior press

name: Round Two
whatItIs: Multi-city consignment chain buying and reselling authenticated secondhand designer streetwear, sneakers, and accessories.
whyNotable: One of few Houston shops built around authenticated resale of luxury streetwear and designer sneakers rather than general thrift.

name: Buffalo Exchange (Montrose)
whatItIs: Buy-sell-trade secondhand clothing store carrying a rotating mix of men's designer and brand-name pieces.
whyNotable: Established Montrose thrift destination where designer menswear occasionally surfaces at deep discounts.

name: Men's Wearhouse
neighborhood: Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Memorial City
whatItIs: Suit and formalwear retailer/tuxedo rental chain founded and headquartered in Houston, serving business and event dressing.
whyNotable: A genuinely Houston-born chain (founded here in 1973) with dedicated in-house tailoring at multiple suburban locations.
evidence: Company website; Houston HQ well documented

name: Jos. A. Bank Clothiers
neighborhood: Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Cypress area
whatItIs: National suiting and business-casual retailer selling suits, dress shirts, and outerwear to professional men.
whyNotable: Known for frequent buy-one-get-several suit promotions and full alterations departments in-store.

name: Von Maur
whatItIs: Upscale department store with a dedicated men's shop selling suiting, sportswear, and dress furnishings.
whyNotable: Known nationally for interest-free financing, free gift wrapping, and hands-on personal shopping for men's suiting.

name: Mr. Formal
neighborhood: Multiple Houston suburbs including Katy, Sugar Land, Pearland
whatItIs: Locally operated tuxedo and suit rental/sales shop outfitting men for weddings, proms, and black-tie events.
whyNotable: A long-running, family-run Houston-area formalwear alternative to the national chains, with fast custom fittings.

name: Circle T Western Wear
whatItIs: Texas western wear retailer selling men's cowboy boots, hats, jeans, and pearl-snap shirts.
whyNotable: A hometown Texas western outfitter offering full head-to-boot western dressing outside the big-box western chains.
